answer: Jittered Arrival Cadence. Each identity emits a heartbeat pulse at a randomized interval drawn from a secret seed; the hub checks inter-arrival variance against that seed. An honest agent's timing matches its registered randomness, while clones inherit the same schedule and cluster into timing collisions that a lightweight jetty filter rejects before admission. Recovering requires regenerating fresh seeds and replaying traffic for a full atlas of observed windows, costing each duplicate hours of real-time scheduling and bandwidth.
